groups.label: Water consumed per kWh of electricity generated (EWIF)

current.label: Water consumed per kWh of electricity generated (EWIF)
current.source_title: United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, 2016)
current.evidence: A national average of 7.6 liters (2.0 gallons) of water are consumed for each kWh when weighting the water losses at both thermoelectric and hydroelectric plants in the U.S.

candidate.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory)
candidate.evidence: In 2023, energy consumption by a data center translates to national average of 4.52 L/kWh of indirect water consumption, along with 0.34 kg/ kWh emissions.
